__HOW_TO_SET_SECRETS: Never commit real secrets here. Set real Neo4j/OpenAI secrets via dotnet user-secrets (see backend/README.md) or environment variables. The Jwt:Key below is a DEV-ONLY placeholder — override it in production.
__REGISTRATION_NOTE: Domains an admin may create accounts for. UserAdminService defaults to tn.ey.com alone when this is unset, which would reject the esprit.tn accounts this build seeds.
__SMTP_NOTE: Left EMPTY on purpose: with Smtp:Host blank the service reports IsConfigured=false and the UI shows the generated password instead of mailing it — the safe local default. To actually deliver credential emails, fill Host/User/Password/From with YOUR OWN account (Gmail needs an App Password). OverrideTo is a TESTING switch that redirects EVERY credentials email to one inbox — leave it empty unless you are deliberately testing the mail flow, and never point it at someone else's mailbox.
